title: Expand failure evidence panel links
summary: Expanded the Reports selected failure detail area and added backend-owned open actions for failure artifacts, repro files, record files, and record folders.
reason: The selected failure evidence panel was too cramped to review comfortably, and operators needed direct links to the artifact and record files shown by the failure row.
behavior_before: The Reports failure detail panel used a narrow two-column layout with a short preformatted area, and selected rows only showed copied text evidence without open actions for artifact or record paths.
behavior_after: The Reports failure detail panel takes substantially more width and height, wraps long evidence text, and selected rows render open buttons that call a backend route which resolves and allowlists artifact, repro, record file, and record folder paths.
